name: intent-formation-state
description: Optional local MCP state companion for Intent Formation.

interface.shortDescription: Optional local state, export, and provenance tools.
interface.longDescription: Adds the local MCP tools for traceable intent records, private mode, correction, feedback, export, import, and physical deletion. The core Intent Formation plugin works without this companion.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the task-local intent state and available privacy controls.
